learningObjectives: Explain how containers package applications and dependencies.
Create a basic deployment architecture for a full stack application.

activities.title: Docker Anatomy
activities.instruction: Explore the major parts of a Docker-based application.

content.concept: A Dockerfile defines how an image is built, an image packages the application and its dependencies, and a container is a running instance of an image.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

descriptions: Contains instructions used to build a Docker image.
A packaged, immutable template containing application code, dependencies, and runtime configuration.
A running instance of a Docker image.
Stores and distributes container images so they can be pulled by deployment environments.
Provides persistent storage that can exist independently of a container's writable layer.

activities.title: Container Workflow
activities.instruction: Arrange the stages from Dockerfile to a running container.

content.concept: A typical Docker workflow creates a Dockerfile, builds an image, optionally pushes it to a registry, pulls it into the deployment environment, and runs it as a container.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Environment Variable Explorer
activities.instruction: Choose the appropriate configuration approach for each value.

content.concept: Environment-specific values such as database URLs, API keys, ports, and deployment settings should be supplied through configuration rather than hard-coded into source code. Secrets should be stored using secure secret-management facilities.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

choices: Store a production API secret in the deployment platform's secret/environment configuration
Commit the production API secret directly into the application's source code
config.answer: Store a production API secret in the deployment platform's secret/environment configuration

activities.title: Deployment Architecture Builder
activities.instruction: Compose a basic deployment architecture for a full stack application.

content.concept: A production architecture can connect a frontend, backend API, database, environment configuration, and external services. Each component should have a clear responsibility and secure connection path.
